localObservationAge.scope: Distinct priced assets among the two local first-page API probes only; genuine block-derived observedAt, compared to check time. Not all176 pricedassets.

findings.metadataOnlyBehavior: Successful xStocks responses often contain createdAt, decimals and stockData but no usdPrice/blockId. stockData is not a Solana token-price substitute.
findings.cadence: Five-minute full metadata universe price sweep plus60-second active-page refresh lowers latency and amortizes requests; does not create missing qualifying trades. Global pacing/backoff required across both paths.
